shots.focal_element: The washG1 cleaner head moving across a bright kitchen floor, later its blue microfibre roller in extreme close-up
shots.what_happens: One continuous (likely CG) camera move: a wide low-angle tracking shot of a person pushing the cleaner over debris on a white kitchen floor (VO w0-w12 states the problem/promise) pushes in to floor level until the head fills the frame, with a glowing translucent x-ray view of the front rollers; the camera then sweeps around and under to an extreme close-up of the blue microfibre roller spinning (w13-w18 'Two microfiber rollers use clean water'), and pulls back to a three-quarter cutaway showing both rollers and red internals as w19-w23 explain 'one washes, the other finishes'.
shots.build_rebuild: Render an 11 s single-take product camera path in 3D (low-angle dolly with person, push-in to floor level, orbit to a macro of the spinning roller, pull back to a cutaway) and fade a translucent emissive x-ray material onto the head shell during the push-in.

shots.focal_element: Cleaner head driving through scattered dirt, then an x-ray cutaway of its rollers and internal tray
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a floor-level head-on view of the cleaner advancing over trails of dirt and spills toward camera (w24-w31 'removing tough stains, spills and dried on dirt'); as it nears, the head turns translucent with glowing blue/red x-ray rings, the camera pushes into the cutaway, then dives inside to a macro of water, debris and the blue roller against a red internal surface (w32-w35 'hygienically cleaning the rollers').
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a CG head driving toward a floor-level camera over a debris decal, crossfade its shell to an emissive x-ray material, then push the camera through the shell into a macro fluid/particle simulation of water and debris on the roller.

shots.focal_element: A spill of food mess on a white kitchen floor beside a cabinet, cleaner at left
shots.what_happens: A 0.12 s (3-frame) segment, seen only as one keyframe: the cleaner approaches a spill of food mess beside a kitchen cabinet. It shows the same scene that opens s004, so it may be a detector split or flash frame rather than a separate shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to the opening frame of the kitchen-spill scene (cleaner at left, debris at lower centre) for 3 frames before the s004 move continues.

shots.focal_element: The cleaner wiping up mess across successive rooms (kitchen, bathroom, living room)
shots.transition_other: detector-flagged soft change; appears continuous with the s003 kitchen-spill frame
shots.what_happens: A floor-level camera follows the cleaner as it clears a food spill along a kitchen cabinet (w36-w37 'leaving kitchens'), carries on into a dark-floored bathroom with puddles (w38 'bathrooms'), then a foreground glass panel/close pass of the cleaner wipes the frame into a wide sunlit living room where a person walks away from the docked cleaner (w39-w43 'and living spaces sparkly clean'); it ends on a low close-up of the head parked on its dock.
shots.build_rebuild: Chain three room environments in one continuous floor-level camera move, using the cleaner body and a glass panel passing close to the lens as wipe elements between rooms, timed so each room appears on its VO noun.

shots.focal_element: Docked cleaner head with glowing x-ray rollers and the clear dirty-water tank above
shots.what_happens: Static-feeling low close-up with a slow push of the cleaner standing in its dock against a wall with soft window shadows; the head shows the translucent x-ray rollers glowing blue and red while the tank shows collected debris, as the VO says w44-w47 'Then it cleans itself'.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a 2 s low-angle close-up of the docked product with a slight camera push and pulse the emissive x-ray roller rings, with soft window-light shadow gobos on the back wall.

shots.shot_type_other: product packshot end card with tagline and wordmark
shots.focal_element: Left-aligned product name and tagline with the upright cleaner standing at right
on_screen_text: Engineered to wash hard floors. Properly.
shots.typography: Left-aligned stack: product name in a lowercase-led geometric sans, medium weight, set as a coloured accent; two-line tagline in sentence case, light/regular geometric sans, normal tracking, larger than the wordmark; brand wordmark in lowercase bold geometric sans below with generous space. Font guess (low confidence): a custom Dyson geometric sans similar to Futura.
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a clean end card: the upright cleaner stands in a soft-lit room at right while the left side holds 'washG1', the tagline 'Engineered to wash hard floors. Properly.' (read exactly by the VO w48-w53) and the dyson wordmark; the frame is static. At about 26.0 s black rectangles begin covering parts of the frame, the start of the transition into s007.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a static 16:9 end card with the product photo anchored at the right third and a left-aligned text stack (accent product name, two-line sans tagline, wordmark) placed at about 15% from the left edge, exiting with black rectangular block wipes.
